text: Which equation is the leaky-integrator ESN state update used in esn.py?
choices: x_{t+1} = alpha*x_t + (1-alpha)*tanh(W_rec x_t + W_in u_{t+1} + b)
x_{t+1} = (1-alpha)*x_t + alpha*tanh(W_rec x_t + W_in u_{t+1} + b)
x_{t+1} = (1-alpha)*x_t + alpha*(W_rec x_t + W_in u_{t+1} + b)
explanation: The leaky-integrator update is x_{t+1} = (1-alpha)x_t + alpha*tanh(W_rec x_t + W_in u_{t+1} + b). Option 1 swaps the alpha and (1-alpha) weights, option 3 drops the tanh nonlinearity, and option 0 wrongly puts the readout W_out inside the state update.
